operations.detail: Remote HEAD, same-owner lease, revision15 queue and absent resource-preflight, hydration, corrected-join and acceptance outputs were revalidated.
Official ArcGIS documentation confirms the item data endpoint streams the actual item file and derives response content type from the item MIME type.
Official OS documentation confirms current OpenData metadata and download-link automation; previous OpenData releases are unavailable through this API.
OS Open UPRN remains June 2026, Great Britain coverage, CSV and GeoPackage, with address-point rather than parcel-boundary semantics.
ONS confirms NSUL and ONSUD Great Britain coverage, six-week release frequency and CSV supply.
Revision15 preview could accept one-source UPRNs; revision16 now requires identical UPRN and normalized postcode in both NSUL and ONSUD.
Full downloads cannot start until response metadata, remaining bytes, download safety factor, 40 GiB SQLite reserve and 8 GiB post-run free space pass.
Content-Range, MIME rejection, cache resume accounting and disk budget calculations passed local code preflight.
OS and relation tables use primary-key WITHOUT ROWID storage; a materialized common table contains only dual-source exact UPRN and postcode agreement.
Normalization, exact join, conflict exclusion, single-source exclusion and preview semantics passed local preflight.
At least 95 percent of the smaller matched NSUL or ONSUD population must agree on identical UPRN and postcode.
Four package hashes, 98 percent source joins, 95 percent common ratio, zero conflicts, 40 dual-source examples and safety flags are enforced.
Sixteen resource, eighteen hydration, eighteen corrected-join, fourteen acceptance and ten pipeline checks contribute to the expanded contract; the new revision16-only suites passed 58 of 58 locally.
The same attempt now targets 64 serial steps, 422 tests and 62 official source checks; no replay, new runner or global-current-task takeover occurred.
No disk preflight, release bytes, corrected dual-source join examples, candidate validation or business-row write is claimed before canonical runner recovery.
Esri item-data, OS Downloads API, OS Open UPRN and ONS UPRN product semantics were committed and read back as a source registry.
Four package rows expose required HTTP, byte, checksum, ZIP and disk checks while all runtime values remain explicitly pending.
Forty deterministic target slots require resource preflight, four-package hydration, same UPRN, same normalized postcode, zero conflicts and no parcel promotion.
